releaseNotes: v1.9.15: upstream 1.9.15-exp.1 parity, plus every WebSocket lane now leaves through the connection's proxy. Realtime Voice, Live Caption and Gemini Live STT dial their upstream through the same proxy chain the HTTP lanes use - the assigned proxy pool, then the legacy per-connection proxy - with a strict pool refusing the session instead of leaking the server's address, and an edge relay (vercel/cloudflare/deno/netlify) dialing direct unless it is strict, because a relay forwards HTTP and cannot tunnel a socket. From upstream: per-custom-provider capacity limits with dashboard editing (#432), Gemini 4 Argon and the OpenCode Go Gemini wire (#382), Gemini-web parity with the stealth bridge (#457), opt-in usageHistory retention (#395), cost estimates in twelve currencies (#397, #405), encrypted nested provider credentials (#428), web-fetch SSRF refusals (#459, #471), spoofed forwarded-header rejection (#452), stream session keys made unique (#447, #467), a 200 with zero usable content no longer cooling an account down (#442, #446, #465), a max_tokens cutoff treated as an answer (#418), client aborts classified by status (#455), and the sidebar collapsed onto one entry list shared with the Settings visibility toggle.
